    homefirm,
    date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM cases
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
case_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    c.headct,
    CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
    CAST(c.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    CASE
      WHEN v.n = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN v.n BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN v.n BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band,
    date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  JOIN emcv v
    ON v.homefirm = c.homefirm
   AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.filekey,
    a.headct,
    a.h1b_dependent,
    a.start_month,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.filekey
      ORDER BY
        (
          CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) DESC,
        r.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM case_attrs a
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = a.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = a.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = a.h1b_dependent)

      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)

          WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12

          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12

  FROM annualized
)

FROM scores;

       + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity,

         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r2
    JOIN main.orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn

           CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small' WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid' WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large' END AS cap_band,
           COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)) AS claim_volume,
           COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey

           snap.warrstate, snap.cap_band, snap.claim_volume, snap.replcost,
           CASE WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single' WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Bulk' END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT t.snapkey, w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,

    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w

     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)

      PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
    ) AS claim_volume,
    COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
  FROM main.plant_record r
  JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT
    snapkey,
    snapts,
    makertag,
    pnlkind,
    alrtstate,
    warrstate,
    cap_band,
    replcost,
    CASE
      WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
      WHEN claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
  FROM snap
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    w.rule_id,
    w.fixed_fee_usd,
    w.cover_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.snapkey
      ORDER BY
        (
          CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) DESC,
        w.rule_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM tiered t
  JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
    ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
   AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
   AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
   AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
   AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
   AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
settled AS (
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    t.snapts,
    t.vol_tier,
    COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
      + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0 * t.replcost AS settlement_usd
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked r
    ON r.snapkey = t.snapkey
   AND r.rn = 1
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
  FROM settled
  WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
    AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
    AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
  GROUP BY vol_tier
)
SELECT
  tiers.vol_tier,
  COALESCE(g.snapshots, 0) AS snapshots,
  g.avg_settlement_usd
FROM (VALUES ('Bulk'), ('Single')) AS tiers(vol_tier)
LEFT JOIN grouped g ON g.vol_tier = tiers.vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE tiers.vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

  SELECT
    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS energy_kwh,

  FROM plant_record r
  JOIN plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
  WHERE m.pnlkind = 'TOPCon'
    AND strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') = '2019-07'
),
potentials AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    energy_kwh / NULLIF(
      (availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0),
      0
    ) AS potential_kwh,
    energy_kwh
  FROM snapshot_losses
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    100.0 * SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh)
      / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS loss_ratio_pct
  FROM potentials
  WHERE potential_kwh IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pnlkind, month
)
SELECT
  CASE

    WHEN loss_ratio_pct < 14 THEN 'Elevated'

    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
),
snapshot_losses AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snapshot_month,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) - energy_kwh AS loss_kwh
    FROM snapshot_yields
    WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
      AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
      AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snapshot_month,
        SUM(potential_kwh) AS total_potential_kwh,
        SUM(loss_kwh) AS total_loss_kwh
    FROM snapshot_losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snapshot_month
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN total_loss_kwh / total_potential_kwh >= 0.14
            THEN total_loss_kwh
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(total_loss_kwh), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM technology_months;

    / NULLIF(SUM((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE

                      * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100), 0)), 0) AS r
  FROM main.plant_record r

  JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey

  END AS loss_band
FROM technology_month

    cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    CASE
      WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2

      homefirm,
      date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
      COUNT(*) AS emcv
    FROM main.cases
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) v
    ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
   AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
g AS (
  SELECT
    ca.filekey,
    r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
    COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours

   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)

  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (

    ORDER BY

  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct,
         CAST(c.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
         pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
         CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
         substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
         cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
         date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
         CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
              WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
              WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
              ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  JOIN (
    SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
           COUNT(*) AS emcv
    FROM main.cases
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) v ON v.homefirm = c.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
    AND year(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2024
), ranked AS (
  SELECT a.filekey, a.headct,
         COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
         COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a.filekey
           ORDER BY
             (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
             r.rule_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM case_attrs a
  LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = a.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = a.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = a.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = a.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = a.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = a.monthly_volume_band)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(base_hours + position_hours * headct), 2) AS employer_review_load_hours
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
